notes: Geometry: import LandmarksReal.glb (3D Importer or Open Cloud Model). Each asset root arrives as a Model of MeshParts named <Asset>_<Role>[_n]. Re-centre with the asset 'origin' (Model.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(origin), then PivotTo(CFrame.new())) as for every other category; boundsMin/boundsMax are relative to that pivot.

Surfaces: every textured part has ONE SurfaceAppearance built from its 'surfaceAppearance' block: ColorMap, NormalMap (OpenGL +Y, MikkTSpace tangents are in the GLB), RoughnessMap (8-bit grayscale) and, for LR_Iron parts only, MetalnessMap (8-bit grayscale). Upload each PNG of textures/LandmarksReal ONCE and share the ids: 5 colour + 5 normal + 5 roughness + 1 metalness = 16 images. The *_MR.png files are the glTF metallicRoughness packing embedded in the GLB (256 px); never upload them. Clear any importer-created TextureID. alphaMode null = leave the default: no LandmarksReal image has an alpha channel. 'rgb' is the texture average (fallback Color).

Roughness maps are Roblox-ready: authored roughness + 0.08 (LookDevPlaybook s.11, Roblox renders glossier than Blender). Roughness/metalness are 512 px (half the colour size, as the playbook recommends).

Tiling: the stone, wood and iron sheets are trim/tile sheets; UVs run outside 0..1 along U (and both ways on the granite tile), so the samplers must repeat (glTF default REPEAT). Check one wall in Studio before mass placement.

Collision: visual parts never collide (CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch false). Parts with role 'Collider' carry all collision and raycasts: Transparency 1, CastShadow false, CanCollide/CanQuery/CanTouch true, CollisionFidelity as listed (CollisionFidelity can only be set at edit time). They are simple convex pieces, so walkable steps and decks stay walkable and every doorway, alcove and launch-plate opening stays open. If Studio's decomposition ever fills an opening, split that Collider by its islands into separate parts.

Ember parts (role Ember: Spire_Ember, Plinth_Ember, Brazier_Ember, Pavilion_Ember, LobbyGate_Ember): Material Neon, Color (255,128,48), no SurfaceAppearance, CastShadow false. Pair each with a real light: Beacon (Spire), Fire (Brazier) and Lantern (Pavilion, LobbyGate) attachments.

Launch plates: SpirePlatform attachments Plate_1..Plate_24 (plaza surface at the 24 openings, LookVector toward the Spire): pivot one Plinth on each. Plinth origin = plaza surface (tread y = 1.5 above it, Stand attachment); its ram reaches 12.3 below the plaza top so it fills the granite tube while the plate rises by LaunchDepth. Carve the terrain under the 24 tubes (radius 3.5, from plaza y = 0.6 down to y = -11.6), or the plate sinks into terrain when lowered.

Spire + SpirePlatform: same origin, unrotated, at the arena centre; the plaza top (0.6) is flush with the Spire's first tread. Spire slit runs along Roblox Z (sky shows through it from north and south).

assets.name: Spire
assets.notes: Hero landmark at the arena centre (origin = arena centre, base on the plaza at y = 0). 'The Cleft': dressed granite tower on a walkable stepped octagon (40 across; 1-stud risers, 2-stud treads, terrace at 3.6), a socle with four gabled alcoves (CrateSlot_1..4 on the alcove floors, LookVector out of the alcove), four buttresses on the diagonals, then a tapering monolith split down its upper half (slit along Roblox Z, so the sky shows through from the front/back), clamped by three riveted iron straps, an iron collar and a forged fire basket. Visual parts are non-colliding; the Collider parts (Transparency 1) carry collision and queries. Spire_Ember = glowing coal bed (Neon, no collision, no shadow): parent the beacon PointLight and fire/smoke emitters to attachment Beacon.

assets.name: SpirePlatform
assets.notes: Place unrotated at the arena centre with the same origin as the Spire, on flat ground. Walking surface y = 0.6, flush with the Spire's first tread; the octagonal hole (apothem 20) is exactly the Spire's bottom slab. Worn granite flagstones (moss and soil in the joints), eight cobbled spokes on the Spire's face axes, a band of setts (r 47.6-56.6) with the 24 launch-plate openings (radius 3.4, centres at r = 52, every 15 degrees clockwise from north = Roblox -Z) and their forged-iron rims, and a granite kerb (r 56.6-60, top 0.95). Under every opening a granite-lined launch tube 12 deep (to y = -11.4): carve the terrain there (e.g. Terrain:FillCylinder with Air, radius 3.5, from y = -11.6 to 0.6). Attachments Plate_1..Plate_24 = opening centres on the plaza surface, LookVector toward the Spire: put each Plinth's pivot there. Visual parts never collide; the Collider parts (Transparency 1) keep the 24 openings open.

assets.name: Plinth
assets.notes: Launch plate. Origin = the plaza surface at the opening centre (SpirePlatform attachment Plate_<n>, plaza y = 0.6): pivot the Plinth there with its LookVector toward the Spire. Worn steel plate 5.6 across (16 facets) with a raised rim and concentric diamond-tread grip rings; tread surface y = 1.5 (attachment Stand, where the contender's feet go); the facet facing the Spire carries Plinth_Ember, a thin light strip (Neon). Below it a steel ram 12 studs long (down to y = -10.8) fills the launch tube while the plate rises, so nothing floats. Lower/raise the whole model by LaunchDepth. Collider = one Hull cylinder (radius 2.8, y -10.8..1.5); the visual parts never collide.

assets.name: Pavilion
assets.notes: Open timber pavilion on a granite base: 24 x 16 under the eaves, ridge ~13.6. Oak deck top y = 0.95 with a granite front step (top 0.42). Eight hewn oak posts on granite pads, wall plates, tie beams and knee braces, a hipped roof of clay pantiles (bellcast eaves) on boarded rafters, half-round ridge and hip tiles. Forged iron lantern under the ridge: put a warm PointLight on attachment Lantern (Pavilion_Ember = its glowing core, Neon). Collision: Collider parts (deck/base and step boxes, eight post boxes, a Hull roof); the timber and tiles never collide.

assets.name: LobbyGate
assets.notes: Granite archway 16 wide, 14 tall: two ashlar piers on a projecting plinth course, moulded imposts, a segmental arch of nine voussoirs with a keystone, coursed spandrels, a cornice and a small hipped roof of clay pantiles. Opening 8.9 wide, 8.9 clear at the imposts, 10.9 under the keystone (the lantern hangs to ~8.4). Old iron gate pintles on the piers. Put a warm PointLight on attachment Lantern (LobbyGate_Ember = the lantern core, Neon). Collision: Collider parts (two pier boxes, convex pieces over the arch, Hull roof); the opening stays open.

assets.name: Brazier
assets.notes: Standing forged-iron brazier ~5.3 tall: three splayed legs with scroll feet, a twisted centre column, a riveted bowl and a crown of curved bars (a miniature of the Spire's fire basket). Brazier_Ember = the coal bed (Neon, no collision/shadow) under charcoal lumps: put the fire ParticleEmitter + warm PointLight on attachment Fire. Good AmbientEmitter for a fire-crackle loop. Collision: one Hull Collider.

assets.name: BannerPole
assets.notes: 12-stud oak pole in a granite socket block, iron collar, spike finial, a crossbar on a forged bracket and a hanging wool banner with the arena's own sigil, the Cleft (a stepped base, a stone monolith split down its upper half, three iron bands, a fire basket and flame) and a swallowtail hem. BannerPole_Banner is cloth: non-colliding, real back faces (DoubleSided off). Collision: two Box Colliders (block, pole).

parts.name: BannerPole_Banner
parts.notes: banner cloth: real back faces, DoubleSided off

assets.name: Bench
assets.notes: Backless bench: two rough granite blocks carrying two thick weathered oak planks held by forged iron straps; seat top y = 1.8. Seat_1/Seat_2 attachments for sit spots. Collision: one Box Collider.

assets.name: NoticeBoard
assets.notes: Notice board: NoticeBoard_Planks is the board, 8 x 6 x 0.3 (x -4..4, y 2.2..8.2 up, 0.3 thick) of eight flush weathered boards; its +Y face (Roblox Front, -Z) is the SurfaceGui face (the GUI sits on the part's bounding-box face, which the board fronts exactly). Attachment Board = centre of that face. Oak frame, two hewn posts on granite pads, braces, and a small pantiled gable roof. Collision: Box Collider for the board and posts, Hull Collider for the roof.

assets.name: Railing
assets.notes: 8-stud segment along X (x = -4..4), 3.6 tall: granite plinth kerb, two dressed granite posts with weathered caps, oak top and bottom rails with square balusters. Tile every 8 studs: the end posts pair up into a double pier. Collision: one Box Collider, so the run acts as a solid barrier.

assets.name: StoneSteps
assets.notes: Three granite steps, 8 wide overall (6.6 walkable between the cheek walls), 1-stud risers, 2-stud treads. Bottom step at the front (+Y); the top tread (y = 3) meets a terrace at z = -3 (Roblox) behind. Each step is two long stones with worn nosings; sloped cheek walls with coping. Collision: Collider pieces (three stacked step blocks + two cheek walls, PreciseConvexDecomposition).
